project-creation.title: New Project
project-creation.selectHelp: Choose the repositories to use in this project.
project-creation.workspaceHelp: All selected repositories form one workspace.
project-creation.orderHelp: Drag a handle to reorder. Or use Space or Enter, Arrow Up/Down, then Space or Enter. Escape cancels. All selected repositories form one workspace.
project-creation.name: Project name
project-creation.nameHelp: Filled from the first selected repository name. You can edit it.
project-creation.loadingMore: Loading more repositories. Search results are incomplete…
project-creation.empty: No registered repositories. Add a repository in Settings → Repositories first.
project-creation.noMatches: No repository names match your search.
project-creation.incomplete: Repository loading failed. Loaded choices and your selections are retained; search results are incomplete.
project-creation.invalidInventory: The repository list is invalid or its page cursor repeated. Reload repositories.
project-creation.unsupportedRepository: This repository cannot be selected. Its name or schema is unavailable.
project-creation.selectRepository: Select at least one repository, with no duplicates and at most 1,000 entries.
project-creation.primaryHelp: The first repository you select becomes the primary repository. You can change it here. The harness starts in this repository. If you remove it while other repositories remain, select a new primary.
project-creation.selectPrimary: Select a primary repository from your selected repositories.
project-creation.invalidName: Enter a project name of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
project-order.picked: Picked up repository {{position}}. Use Arrow Up or Down, then Space or Enter to commit. Escape cancels.
project-order.completed: Repository order committed at position {{position}}. Save the project to keep this order.
project-order.canceled: Movement canceled. Repository restored to position {{position}}.
